backend.routing_engine: OSRM public highway routing with OpenRouteService fallback
backend.budget_service: Authoritative cost engine (fuelRequired * fuelRate + tolls + stays + meals)
backend.geocoding: Mapbox Geocoding API with Nominatim fallback

web.hosting: GitHub Pages (gh-pages branch) with custom domain voyplan.in

invariants: Trip fuel cost in budget MUST ALWAYS reflect total fuel consumed for the journey (fuelRequired * fuelPricePerLiter). Out-of-pocket top-up is a separate secondary metric.
Round-trip routes must preserve user stops and have route origin equal to route destination.
Jest tests in backend must always be run with --forceExit because Supabase and websocket listeners remain open.
Never commit files exceeding 100MB to GitHub (use deploy_web.sh guard for APK files).
